notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.
